nombre: Los otros parecidos y las señales
objetivo: araña vascular, granuloma piógeno, melanoma rojo; las señales de alarma y el patito feo

momentos.p: Now let's talk about the other lookalikes, quickly.
momentos.porque: 'los otros parecidos, rápido' → él repartiendo fotos de lesiones sobre el escritorio como cartas
momentos.prompt: sitting at his desk quickly laying out a row of printed close-up photos of different red skin spots like playing cards, focused and brisk with a slight half-smile, a magnifying glass on the desk, a mug, a stethoscope, a stack of folders, a desk lamp, bookshelf with plant, framed mountain print, daylight
momentos.motion: he flips down one more photo card onto the row

momentos.p: several new ones on your face, neck or chest
momentos.porque: 'varias nuevas en cara, cuello o pecho' → una señora descubriendo arañitas en el cuello con el espejo de mano
momentos.prompt: medium shot of a 62-year-old woman in a bathrobe holding a small compact mirror up to her neck, looking at two tiny spider-like red spots with thin radiating vessels on her neck and upper chest, concerned narrowed eyes, a vanity with a hairdryer, a jar of cotton balls, a phone face down, a towel on her shoulder, bright bathroom light
momentos.motion: she tilts the compact mirror and lifts her chin

momentos.p: a spot called a pyogenic granuloma
momentos.porque: 'granuloma piógeno' → un bultito rojo, húmedo, en el dedo
momentos.prompt: close shot of the side of an older man's index finger near the nail with a small raised raw-looking wet red bump like a tiny raspberry, a loosened adhesive bandage beside it, a garden-rough knuckle, a workbench surface with a tape measure and a pencil, warm garage light
momentos.motion: the finger turns slowly to show the bump from the side

momentos.p: bleeds with the slightest touch
momentos.porque: 'sangra con el mínimo roce' → el pañuelo con una gota tras apenas tocarlo
momentos.prompt: medium shot of an older man at a kitchen table dabbing his finger with a white paper napkin that already shows a small bright red spot, his face surprised and annoyed, a box of adhesive bandages opened, a pair of reading glasses, a coffee cup, a newspaper, a window with daylight
momentos.motion: he dabs the finger again and looks at the napkin

momentos.p: And there is a rare one I don't want to skip.
momentos.porque: 'hay uno raro que no quiero saltear' → él se inclina hacia cámara, serio
momentos.prompt: leaning forward in his office chair with elbows on his knees and hands clasped, looking straight toward the camera with a serious, caring expression and slightly lowered brows, a stethoscope around his neck, a desk with a closed laptop behind him, a bookshelf, a plant, a framed mountain print, soft window light
momentos.motion: he leans in a little more and clasps his hands tighter

momentos.p: can be red or pink instead of brown
momentos.porque: 'pueden ser rojos o rosados en vez de marrones' → un bulto rosado-rojizo irregular en un hombro
momentos.prompt: close shot of the sun-damaged shoulder of a 70-year-old fair-skinned man with one irregular pink-red raised bump with uneven edges and a slightly crusted spot, clearly different from two small round cherry dots nearby, freckles and sunspots, a tan line from a tank top, a white paper exam gown slipping off, clinic light
momentos.motion: the gown slides a little off the shoulder

momentos.p: Show a red spot to a doctor if it grows quickly over weeks.
momentos.porque: 'si crece rápido en semanas' → la cinta métrica junto a un bulto que creció
momentos.prompt: close shot of a flexible cloth measuring tape held by an older woman's fingers next to a red raised bump on her forearm, a pen mark dot beside it on the skin, a spiral notebook with a pencil lying below, a kitchen table with a coffee cup, morning window light
momentos.motion: her fingers slide the tape measure along the bump

momentos.p: If it changes shape, or the edge becomes irregular.
momentos.porque: 'si cambia de forma o el borde se vuelve irregular' → un punto con borde desparejo bajo la lupa
momentos.prompt: close shot through a magnifying glass of a red spot on older back skin with a ragged irregular notched edge instead of a round one, a gloved fingertip pointing at the notch, the steel rim of the magnifier, a paper exam sheet, bright clinic light
momentos.motion: the magnifying glass moves slowly along the ragged edge

momentos.p: If it turns black or blue.
momentos.porque: 'si se pone negro o azul' → un punto oscuro azulado entre los rojos
momentos.prompt: close shot of the belly skin of an older man with several bright red cherry dots and one that has turned dark blue-black, the waistband of khaki pants, a leather belt, a fine line of hair, warm living room lamp light
momentos.motion: his fingers pull the waistband down a little to show the dark spot

momentos.p: If it bleeds again and again without being scratched.
momentos.porque: 'si sangra una y otra vez sin rascarse' → la camiseta con manchitas en el mismo lugar
momentos.prompt: medium shot of a white cotton undershirt laid on a laundry room counter showing three small old brownish-red blood spots in the same place on the chest, an older woman's hands holding it up, a bottle of stain remover without label, a laundry basket, a washing machine with the lid open, fluorescent light
momentos.motion: her hands lift the shirt closer to the light

momentos.p: If it becomes an open sore that doesn't heal.
momentos.porque: 'si se vuelve una herida que no cierra' → una llaguita abierta en la piel del pecho
momentos.prompt: close shot of the upper chest of an older man with a small open shallow sore that has a crusted edge and does not look healed, a used bandage with its paper backing lying beside it on the bathroom counter, the neckline of a grey t-shirt, a tube of ointment, bathroom light
momentos.motion: his fingers peel back the edge of the shirt collar

momentos.p: the one spot that looks different from all the others
momentos.porque: 'el que es distinto a todos' → espalda con muchos puntos rojos iguales y uno oscuro raro
momentos.prompt: close-medium shot of the freckled upper back of a 72-year-old man sitting on a paper-covered exam table, dozens of similar small round cherry-red dots and among them one larger dark brown-black irregular spot that looks nothing like the others, a gloved finger pointing right at that one, the edge of his folded shirt, a lamp arm, clinic light
momentos.motion: the gloved finger taps next to the odd dark spot

momentos.p: If dozens of new cherry angiomas appear suddenly
momentos.porque: 'si aparecen decenas de golpe' → un señor alarmado viendo en el espejo un montón de puntitos nuevos
momentos.prompt: medium shot of a 66-year-old man lifting his polo shirt up to his chin in front of a bedroom closet mirror, staring at dozens of small new red dots across his chest and belly with wide eyes and raised eyebrows, his other hand holding his phone, a bed with a suitcase half unpacked, a lamp, a window with afternoon light
momentos.motion: he lifts the shirt higher and turns his torso toward the mirror

momentos.p: a sudden eruption is worth a conversation and a basic checkup
momentos.porque: 'vale una charla y un chequeo' → él conversando con ese paciente, tomándole la presión
momentos.prompt: wrapping a blood pressure cuff around the arm of a seated older man in a polo shirt while talking to him with an easy, attentive smile, a stethoscope in his ears ready, a small table with a lab request clipboard, a box of gloves, an exam table, a framed mountain print, daylight
momentos.motion: he tightens the cuff and squeezes the bulb gently

componentes.p: Then there is a spot called a pyogenic granuloma.
componentes.title: Pyogenic granuloma
componentes.desc: grows fast, looks raw, bleeds easily

componentes.p: What gives them away is behavior.
componentes.caption: growing, changing, bleeding, looking different

componentes.p: So here are the warning signs.
componentes.title: Show a doctor if it...

componentes.p: If it becomes an open sore that doesn't heal.
componentes.title: Show a doctor if it...

componentes.p: Dermatologists call that the ugly duckling sign
componentes.title: The ugly duckling sign
componentes.desc: the one spot unlike all the others

componentes.p: over just a few weeks or months, mention it at your next visit
componentes.eyebrow: NEW ONES, IN A FEW WEEKS
componentes.caption: mention it at your next visit

momentos.p: if you catch one with a razor
momentos.porque: 'si te lo llevás con la afeitadora' → afeitándose el cuello, una gotita en un puntito
momentos.prompt: medium shot of a 70-year-old man shaving his neck at the bathroom mirror with a disposable razor and white foam on his jaw, a small bead of bright red blood on a red dot at the side of his neck, his mouth tightening in an 'ouch', a can of shaving foam, a towel over his shoulder, a toothbrush cup, white tiles, morning light
momentos.motion: he pulls the razor away and a tiny drop of blood rolls down

momentos.p: it can bleed a surprising amount
momentos.porque: 'puede sangrar muchísimo' → la toalla blanca con gotas rojas junto a la pileta
momentos.prompt: medium shot of a white hand towel crumpled on a bathroom counter beside the sink with several bright red blood drops soaked into it, a few drops in the white sink basin, a razor, a bar of soap, the man's hand pressing a corner of the towel to his neck at the edge of the frame, chrome faucet, morning light
momentos.motion: a drop falls into the sink and the hand presses the towel

momentos.p: It looks dramatic, but it is usually easy to stop.
momentos.porque: 'parece dramático pero se para fácil' → él con las manos abiertas pidiendo calma, sonriendo
momentos.prompt: sitting on the front edge of his desk with both palms lowered in a calm-down gesture, relaxed reassuring smile and soft eyes, a roll of gauze and a box of adhesive bandages beside him on the desk, a stethoscope around his neck, a bookshelf with a plant, a framed mountain print, daylight
momentos.motion: he lowers his palms slowly and nods

momentos.p: press firmly on the spot
momentos.porque: 'apretá firme sobre el punto' → el señor sentado apretando una gasa doblada en el pecho
momentos.prompt: medium shot of a 71-year-old man sitting calmly on a kitchen chair with his shirt open, pressing a folded square of white gauze firmly against a spot on his chest with two fingers, patient and steady expression, a mechanical kitchen timer on the table beside a glass of water, an opened pack of gauze, a radio, a window with daylight
momentos.motion: he keeps steady pressure while the second hand of the wall clock moves

momentos.p: hold the pressure for ten full minutes without peeking
momentos.porque: 'diez minutos sin espiar' → el timer de cocina girado a diez minutos
momentos.prompt: close shot of a round white mechanical kitchen egg timer on a wooden table turned to ten minutes, a folded gauze pad and its torn paper wrapper beside it, the corner of a glass of water, a man's knee in khaki pants at the edge, warm daylight
momentos.motion: the dial of the timer ticks slowly backward

momentos.p: then it's time to get help
momentos.porque: 'ahí es momento de pedir ayuda' → entrando a un centro de atención rápida con la gasa en el pecho
momentos.prompt: wide shot of an older man in an open jacket walking into a small urgent care clinic waiting room while holding a folded gauze against his chest, his wife at his side talking to the receptionist behind a glass window, rows of chairs, a water cooler, a potted plant, a wall-mounted TV turned off, bright fluorescent light
momentos.motion: the glass entry door swings closed behind them

componentes.p: hold the pressure for ten full minutes
componentes.caption: longer if you take blood thinners

nombre: Lo que hace la gente en casa
objetivo: el error: quemar, cortar, atar, vinagre, lapiceras; por qué no

momentos.p: burn these spots off with a hot needle
momentos.porque: 'quemarlos con una aguja caliente' → la aguja sobre el encendedor en la mesada del baño
momentos.prompt: medium shot of a bathroom counter at night with an older man's hand holding a sewing needle over the flame of a plastic lighter, a hand mirror propped against the wall, a bottle of rubbing alcohol without label, cotton balls, a box of matches, a toothbrush cup, a dim vanity bulb, tense shadows
momentos.motion: the lighter flame flickers under the needle tip

momentos.p: cut them with nail clippers, tie a thread around them
momentos.porque: 'cortarlos con el cortaúñas, atarlos con hilo' → las herramientas caseras listas sobre la toalla
momentos.prompt: medium shot of a folded white towel on a bathroom counter with a pair of steel nail clippers, a spool of white sewing thread with a loose end, small scissors, tweezers and an opened box of adhesive bandages laid out, a magnifying hand mirror, a drip on the faucet, pale tiles, warm vanity light
momentos.motion: the loose end of the thread slides off the spool

momentos.p: put apple cider vinegar or garlic on them
momentos.porque: 'vinagre de manzana o ajo' → algodón empapado, ajo pelado y el frasco sobre la mesada
momentos.prompt: medium shot of a kitchen counter with a glass bottle of amber apple cider vinegar without label, a cotton ball soaked amber, a peeled crushed garlic clove on a saucer, a roll of medical tape, a small knife, a cutting board, a lemon, morning window light
momentos.motion: a drop of vinegar runs down the side of the bottle

momentos.p: one of those online remover pens that burns the skin
momentos.porque: 'esas lapiceras quita-manchas de internet' → el aparatito sacado de la caja de envío
momentos.prompt: medium shot of a cheap plastic pen-shaped skin spot removal device with a thin metal needle tip and a small USB cable, lying on its crumpled plastic packaging inside an opened small shipping box on a living room coffee table, a pair of reading glasses, a TV remote, a coaster with a glass, lamp light
momentos.motion: the tiny indicator light on the pen blinks

momentos.p: leave a white scar that looks worse than the red dot ever did
momentos.porque: 'una cicatriz blanca peor que el punto' → la marca blanca y brillante en la piel del pecho
momentos.prompt: close shot of the chest skin of an older man with a shiny white round scar with pinkish edges where a spot was burned off, next to two untouched small red cherry dots, fine chest hairs, the collar of a light blue shirt, soft bathroom light
momentos.motion: his fingertip touches the scar lightly

momentos.p: you just destroyed the evidence a doctor needed to see
momentos.porque: 'destruiste la evidencia que el médico necesitaba' → él con un frasquito de muestra vacío, serio
momentos.prompt: standing at the clinic counter holding up a small empty clear specimen jar with a white lid, looking at it and then at the camera with a serious, slightly frustrated expression and tight lips, a microscope and a rack of slides beside him, a box of gloves, a sharps container, fluorescent light, a framed mountain print
momentos.motion: he turns the empty jar slowly in his fingers

componentes.p: I have seen patients who tried to burn these spots off

nombre: Sacarlos bien y qué pasa en la consulta
objetivo: opciones seguras en el consultorio, costo, laboratorio, dermatoscopio sin drama

momentos.p: one catches on your clothes
momentos.porque: 'uno se engancha en la ropa' → la lana del suéter enganchada en el punto
momentos.prompt: close shot of an older woman pulling a chunky knit cream wool sweater over her head, a loop of yarn catching on a raised red dot on her upper chest, her fingers freeing the thread, a bedroom dresser with a jewelry dish, soft morning light
momentos.motion: her fingers unhook the yarn from the spot

momentos.p: A doctor or a dermatologist can remove them safely in the office
momentos.porque: 'se sacan seguro en el consultorio' → él con el electrocauterio fino, guantes, en el hombro de la paciente
momentos.prompt: wearing blue exam gloves and magnifying loupes pushed up on his forehead, holding a slim pen-like electric cautery device near a small red dot on the shoulder of a relaxed older woman lying on her side on an exam table, calm concentrated expression, a steel tray with gauze, a numbing cream tube, a surgical lamp, a framed mountain print, bright clinic light
momentos.motion: he brings the tip of the device slowly toward the dot

momentos.p: a laser that targets the red color
momentos.porque: 'un láser que apunta al rojo' → la paciente con antiparras y el cabezal del láser
momentos.prompt: medium shot of a dermatology treatment room, a 68-year-old man lying back on a treatment chair wearing dark protective goggles, a gloved technician holding a laser handpiece with a small glowing tip over a red dot on his chest, the laser machine console on a cart, a cooling fan, a box of gloves, soft dimmed lights
momentos.motion: the tip of the handpiece glows and moves to the next dot

momentos.p: ask about the cost before you book
momentos.porque: 'preguntá el costo antes de sacar turno' → una señora al teléfono con su tarjeta de la obra social
momentos.prompt: medium shot of a 67-year-old woman sitting at her dining table on the phone, holding a blank plastic insurance card in her other hand and reading glasses on her nose, a notepad and pen, a calendar, a cup of coffee, a bowl of apples, a window with a garden view and daylight
momentos.motion: she turns the card over while listening

momentos.p: called a dermatoscope
momentos.porque: 'se llama dermatoscopio' → él mirando el punto del pecho con el dermatoscopio pegado al ojo
momentos.prompt: leaning close to the chest of an older man on an exam table and holding a small black handheld dermatoscope with a lit lens up to his eye against a red dot, one eye closed, curious focused expression, his other hand gently steadying the patient's shoulder, a box of gloves, a paper roll, an exam lamp, a framed mountain print, daylight
momentos.motion: he adjusts the dermatoscope a little and squints

momentos.p: almost like a bunch of tiny grapes
momentos.porque: 'como un racimo de uvas chiquitas' → la vista de cerca con lagunas rojas redondas y un racimo al lado
momentos.prompt: close shot of a magnified view of a cherry angioma through the glass lens of a dermatoscope: many round red and dark purple pockets packed together like a tiny bunch of grapes, separated by thin pale lines, the round black rim of the lens with its ring of small lights, and beside the instrument on a steel tray a small bunch of red grapes, clinic light
momentos.motion: the ring of lights brightens a little and the view drifts

momentos.p: No needles, no blood test, no drama.
momentos.porque: 'sin agujas, sin análisis, sin drama' → él sacándose los guantes, sonriente, y el paciente abotonándose
momentos.prompt: pulling off his blue exam gloves with a relaxed easy grin while an older man on the exam table buttons his shirt back up and laughs, a trash bin, a paper roll, a box of tissues, a framed mountain print, a potted plant, daylight
momentos.motion: he tosses the gloves into the bin and the patient finishes buttoning
